summary:
migrate-kb plan: migration-tools r1-r17 has 38 scenarios; 22 are red and 16 pass, and the feature file does not change.
Code: requests/ and adrs/ moves (r8, r14); kinds and short capability ids (r9); unnumbered ledger entries numbered from the ledger alone (r13); superseded status and qualifier split (r2, r17); formulated_as removed (r6); dirty-tree refusal (r15); git add plus the decisions index written by model's own writer (r16); retired-parse traceback made a named refusal (r7).
C1: a dirty tree is refused together with every other failure, so the untracked-file r7 scenarios keep their move or write messages.
C2: migrate does not create spec/index.md. The r6 Givens give the repository one (r4, design-decision/migration-in-one-pass, existing row-1 Given).
Test side: steps reworded to the feature's text, the r11 state fix, r6 Then asserts only unresolved and problems, and record bodies long enough for git rename detection.
Open: no spec/index.md, malformed --context, empty date or source, supersedes outside the ledger.
